embeddings.title: Embedding Models
embeddings.subtitle: Convert document text and queries into vectors for semantic search.
embeddings.primaryDesc: Microsoft E5 (large). Multilingual, works with RU/EN and mixed texts. Recommended as primary.
embeddings.fallbackDesc: LaBSE. Connects automatically if the primary is unavailable. More compact and faster, but less accurate.

searchParams.title: Search Parameters
searchParams.subtitle: Control the volume of data for analysis. Larger values are more accurate but slower.
searchParams.candidateNDesc: How many fragments to retrieve from the index in the first phase. The best ones are selected for the LLM.
searchParams.contextKDesc: How many of the best fragments to pass to the LLM as context for each check.

hybridWeights.title: Hybrid Search Weights
hybridWeights.subtitle: Three signal sources: semantics, keywords, metadata. The sum must be greater than zero.
hybridWeights.denseDesc: Embedding similarity. Finds paraphrased formulations and cross-language matches.
hybridWeights.denseIncrease: Increase for: multilingual documents, search by meaning.
hybridWeights.sparseDesc: Classic token-based search. Precisely finds terms, article numbers, specific formulations.
hybridWeights.sparseIncrease: Increase for: monolingual documents, search for specific clauses.
hybridWeights.metaDesc: Boost for metadata matches: section headers, fragment position in the document.
hybridWeights.sumValid: Valid configuration. Sum is recalculated when weights change.
hybridWeights.sumError: Sum must be greater than zero.
